correctness.rationale: The identifying-set equivalence to hitting neighborhoods and pairwise symmetric differences is exact. Full enumeration checks all subsets through dimension six; a complete pivot-branch hitting search with sound disjoint-unmet-set lower-bound pruning proves no 11-detector solution at dimension seven and lists every 12-detector solution. A separate reversal-orbit exhaustive count and alternate C++ verifier reproduce all listed data. No result above seven is claimed.

evidence: Castro et al. show Aut(Γ_n) ≅ Z₂ via reversal, and give exact different invariants (domination and 2-packing).
Ren proves bounds for γ(Γ_n), a weaker necessary condition for identification.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: None of these stronger-looking ambient descriptions supplies both every nonempty signature and all pairwise symmetric-difference hitting requirements; none implies the optimizer counts or reversal penalty. The automorphism theorem is directly used, but does not solve the identification problem.

value.rationale: A natural monitoring optimization on well-studied interconnection networks is completely classified through 34 vertices. The first extra-detector cost for the graph’s only nontrivial automorphism occurs at dimension five and disappears at dimensions six and seven; all optimizer populations and reversal classes are determined. The object and precise invariant are motivated independently of the computation.
